name: ntfy
description: Send push notifications through your own self-hosted ntfy server. Add one or more servers with an access token in the plugin settings; Cindy encrypts each token and sends it only to its own server.
whenToUse: Use when the user wants a push notification sent to their phone or desktop through their own ntfy server, for example to be alerted when a task finishes. Requires a server and access token added in the plugin settings.
author: Rui Valim

connections.label: ntfy server
connections.hint: Enter the server URL (https only, default port 443, served at the domain root) and an ntfy access token (tk_...) with write access to your topics.

tools.name: ntfy_send
tools.description: Publish one push notification to a topic on a configured ntfy server. Returns the ntfy message id and time. topic defaults to the server's default topic. With several servers configured, pass server (id or host from ntfy_servers); ask the user if unsure. message is limited to 4096 UTF-8 bytes and is rejected, never truncated, when longer. Never resend after an outcome-unknown error (timeout, network failure, HTTP 5xx): the notification may already have been delivered, so ask the user first.

message.description: Notification body. Required, non-empty, at most 4096 UTF-8 bytes.

topic.description: ntfy topic (letters, digits, - and _, up to 64 characters). Omit to use the server's default topic.

title.description: Optional notification title. Any Unicode text, accents included.

priority.description: Optional priority: 1-5 or min, low, default, high, urgent. Use high or urgent only when the user asked for it.

tags.description: Optional tags. Tags matching an ntfy emoji short code (for example warning, white_check_mark) show as emojis.

click.description: Optional https:// URL opened when the notification is tapped.

markdown.description: Set true to render the message as Markdown in clients that support it.

server.description: Server id or host from ntfy_servers. Optional when exactly one server is configured; required when there are several.

tools.name: ntfy_servers
tools.description: List the configured ntfy servers with their id, host, URL and default topic. Access tokens are never returned. Use it to choose the server argument for ntfy_send.
